::: {#thm-ols-slr-vector}
#### OLS estimates in vector notation

Suppose $S_{xx} > 0$ (@def-centered-sums).
Then the matrix $A = \sumin \soprod{\vxi}$ is invertible,
and the vector of OLS estimates (@def-ols) is

$$
\hvcoef = A^{-1} \v{c},
\qquad
\v{c} = \sumin \vxi y_i.
$$

Its entries are the estimates of @thm-ols-slr.
:::

::: proof

$\text{RSS}$ is differentiable,
so any point that minimizes it solves the [normal equations](#def-normal-equations).
By @exr-normal-equations-vector,
the normal equations are $A \vcoef = \v{c}$.
By @exr-solve-normal-equations-vector,
$A$ is invertible,
so their only solution is $A^{-1} \v{c}$,
whose entries are those of @thm-ols-slr.
By @exr-rss-hessian-vector,
the Hessian of $\text{RSS}$ is positive definite at every $\vcoef$,
so $\text{RSS}$ is strictly convex
and $A^{-1} \v{c}$ is its unique global minimum.

:::
